title: A maximal chain ending at a closed point of an integral finite-type scheme
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X$ be a nonempty integral scheme locally of finite type over $K$ [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], let $\eta$ be its generic point and put $L=\mathcal O_{X,\eta}$, its function field. Write $r=\operatorname{trdeg}_K L$ [def-kun-transcendence-degree]. Then there exist a closed point $x\in X$ [def-weil-closed-points] and points $\xi_{-r},\ldots,\xi_0=x$ forming a chain of specializations $\xi_{-r}\leadsto\cdots\leadsto\xi_0$ of length $r$ (that is, $\xi_i\in\overline{\{\xi_{i-1}\}}$ and $\xi_i\neq\xi_{i-1}$ for $-r<i\leq0$), with $\xi_{-r}=\eta$; moreover $\kappa(x)$ is a finite extension of $K$.
